title: Donut-Bal-Tag
description: Shows DonutSMP player balances near nametags after linking with /api.
body:
Donut Bal Tag is a client-side Fabric mod made for `donutsmp.net`.

After joining DonutSMP, run `/api` once to link your DonutSMP API token. The mod saves the token locally and uses the official DonutSMP API to show nearby players’ balances near their nametags.

The mod only activates on DonutSMP and does not require any server-side installation.
